tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ na mo gu ru he badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma dzaḥ tsakra saṃ bha ra mahā ma ya badz+ra bhai ra ba mahā kā la maṇ+ḍa le bh+yaḥ mthar thug ston pa rnam pa lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de yi sgrub thabs man ngag bzhin gsal por 'god la spro ba skyes/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje drag po gdan can gyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la gzhi byas nas rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa'i tshul ni 'di yin te/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas spyi dang mthun par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus rang gi snying gar thim nas zhu ba'i thig le las/ bdag nyid dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang dbang phyug gi gdan la gnas pa'i snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ de las khro bo bcu spros phyogs bcur 'khod pa ni/ shar du gshin rje gshed nag po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje gdengs pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor gtum mo nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu 'dod rgyal sngo dmar lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub byang du be con sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du stobs po che nag po tri shu la 'dzin pa/ steng du gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ mi g.yo 'dod rgyal gnod mdzes rnams rol pa'i khro bo/ gzhan rnams shin tu khros pa/ thams cad kyang stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ khro bo'i mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa me dpung dang bcas pa'o/ khro bo bcu las khro bo bcu lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/

phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams kyi yan lag lnga zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus snying gar btab ste bkug par gyur/ oṃ ya mān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pradz+nyān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ pad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ ār+yā tsa la hūṃ/ oṃ ṭak+ki rā dza hūṃ/ oṃ nī la dan+ṭa hūṃ/ oṃ mahā ba la hūṃ/ oṃ tsakra wārti hūṃ/ oṃ sum+bha rā dza hūṃ/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūṃ/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya hūṃ/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bid+yā rā dza hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yang hūṃ las phur bu dang tho ba bcu spros/ yang spul khro bo rnams kyi lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtod/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btab cing tho bas brdungs pas/ lus g.yo 'gul med/ ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems 'od gsal du thim zhing*/ lhag ma rnams rdo rje'i me 'od dang sngags kyi sgras khor yug chen po'i phyi rol du bskrad par gyur/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+tāṃ na phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ badz+ra kī la badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pa ya ti sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga ra badz+ra kī la ā ko ṭa ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ rang nyid mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas mā ma kī la 'khyud pa/ rlung kha sbyor bya/ rtsa gsum gsal btab nas/ a wa dhū tā+-i rab tu rgyas pa'i nang gi snying gar hūṃ mthing nag /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying ga'i hūṃ las raṃ chad de 'og tu nyi mar gyur/ yang hūṃ gcig chad de/ de'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur pa ni/ shar gyi rwa gsum dkar po/ lho'i rwa gsum ser po/ nub kyi rwa gsum dmar po/ byang gi rwa gsum ljang khu/ lte ba mthing nag la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje de nyid rgya che zhing rngams 'thug par gyur pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi/

khor yug tu 'phros pa dpangs mtho pas rā ba/ rtse mo rnams steng du 'dus pa gur dang bla bre/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ phyogs bzhir dmigs nas hūṃ bzhi pa lan gcig brjod/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyi sne la rdo rje rtse gcig pa nas rtse dgu pa'i bar gyi rdo rje rnams 'phros te go mtshams med par gtams/ yang rak+ṣa 'i sngags brjod pas/ 'og gi nyi ma las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi me 'bar bas/ phyi ngos kyi rdo rje rnams khro chu ltar zhu nas/ me long gi ngos bzhin du gyur pas bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi thar zhing bar du gcod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs pa'i bsrung 'khor ye shes kyi me 'bar bas dpag tshad bye ba tsam du khyab par gyur/ badz+ra rak+ṣa 'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin dpung 'khrigs pa bzhin bzhugs par gyur/ bla med dkon mchog rnam pa gsum/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ khro bo chos skyong bcas pa la/ /rtag tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum/ bla ma yi dam 'khor bcas kyis/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gyi don du rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs sgrub pa ni shin tu legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyi bar chad nga yis bsrung zhing byin gyis rlabs par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bkrus par gyur/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje la sogs pa byon nas rang dang dbyer med du gyur/ rtsa sngags/ kha bkrus la bdud rtsi myang*/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gis pha ma yin/ pha ma 'di rnams sdug bsngal ba snying re rje/ da ni bdag gis bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/

rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bzhag par bya/ de'i phyir du bdag gis rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor sgrub par bgyi'o/ / de nas/ rang skad cig gis dgyes mdzad rdo rje phyag gnyis pa shes rab ma dang bcas par gsal ba'i snying gar raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ/ de las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pas rang gi lus kyi nad thams cad sbyangs/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'phros pas sha khrag la sogs pa bar gyi dngos po rnams kyang sbyangs te ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ yang 'phros pa ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor lnga'i lha tshogs bla mas dbu rgyan pa sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong sogs/ /bdag gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma dza tsakra sam+bha ra mahā ma ya badz+ra bhai ra ba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ bcom ldan dgyes mdzad dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gsang 'dus mahā ma ya dang*/ / bde mchog 'khor lo 'jigs byed de/ /yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /chos skyong tshogs dngabacas pa la/ /bdag sogs gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ar+ghaṃ= pād+yaṃ ste chu gnyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar phul/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ / ghasma ri ni sman 'dzin cing*/ /puk+ka si ni rdo rje'i lag/de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung*/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/

/ 'dod chags chen po rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ / de nas rgyun bshags ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*/ /bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba/ /sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi/ /bsgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi/ /tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*/ /bla ma rgyud sde'i lha rnams kyi/ /sems can rgyud la gang 'tsham pa'i/ / gang 'dul de la der bstan nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas dag la ma 'khod par/ /de srid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ /chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar/ /skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar/ /de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di dag gis/ /'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*/ /sems can sdug bsngal gzir las sgrol bar shog /bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas la/ /bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum ni/ /ltos med sems can don du 'bul/ /khyod kyi sku gsum 'grub par shog / de nas / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang la sogs pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba yang bya'o/ / sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shung+ngha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shung+ngho3haṃ/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla bre me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs shing*/

rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa'i nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po baṃ dang bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi laṃ dang rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu drug pa lte ba la bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las pad nyi sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas pa'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che pha gu las dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dabs las thur du 'phyang ba'i shar bu'i phreng ba dang*/ steng du mda' yab mchod rten gyi dbyibs can gyis bskor ba'i bar bar na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhi mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'gram stegs mchod pa'i snam bu dmar po la bud med sgyu ma'i mdzes sdug gis sgeg pa'i gzungs ma rnams kyis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa/ zur bzhir zla phyed nor bu dang*/ sgo 'khyud kyi mtshams su zla phyed rdo rjes brgyan pa/ sgo bzhi'i mdun du rgyan dang bcas pa'i ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs mchod rten gyi rnam pa can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rta babs kyi rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos 'khor/ steng du gdugs dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/

gzhan yang rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i gzhal yas khang glang rgyab kyi nang de bzhin gshegs pa lngas mdzes pa/ sgo bzhi'i phyi rol du rin po che'i them skas dang*/ de'i pha rol du babs zhon gyi rta babs dang bcas pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar du gtum dragalhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu mun pa mi zad pa/ nub byang du ca co sgrog pa/ byang shar du ha ha rgod pa'o/ /shing chen po brgyad ni/ ha ra tsu ta a sho ka a shwad tha dang ka rañja/ dza la ti dang par ti pa/ bhe ta dang ni bha ṭa'o/ /rtsa bar phyogs skyong brgyad gnas pa/ / shar du brgya byin lhor gshin rje/ /chu lha nub dang gnod sbyin byang*/ /byang shar 'byung po shar lho me/ /lho nub srin po nub byang rlung*/ /mkha' la lha chen brgyad gnas pa/ /shar du dbang po lhor tshangs pa/ /khyab 'jug nub dang dbang phyug byang*/ /byang shar la sogs mtshams bzhi ru/ /gdong drug tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ /bhṛṃ gi ri ti legs ldan nag/chu la klu chen brgyad gnas pa/ /'jog po dung skyong rigs ldan dang*/ /mtha' yas pad chen dga' bo dang*/ /nor rgyas bu dang pad+ma'o/ /shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong rnams phyogs skyong so so'i mdog dang mtshungs shing so so'i bzhon pa'i gdong pa can gri gug dang thod pa gtor mas gang ba 'dzin pa'o/ /sprin chen po brgyad ni/ sgrog byed ser po/ ldog byed sngon po/ 'jigs byed dkar po/ 'khor byed ser po/ 'thug po dkar po/ 'gengs byed dmar po/ char 'bebs nag po/ gtum po ljang khu'o/ /gzhan yang ri brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ chu brgyad/ drag tu 'bar ba'i me brgyad dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang ro dang ro langs dang sha za dang 'byung po dang srin po dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma grub pa thob pa dang*/

grub pa'i rdzas dang mchod rdzas thams cad kyis gang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod/ de rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ phyogs bzhi dmar ba me dang rlung ser ba/ bden bral ljang pa/ dbang ldan sngo ba/ mtha' ma rdo rje nag po'i mu khyud kyis bskor ba/ lte bar nyi ma'i gdan la bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po kham ser/ nye dbang ljang khu/ drag po thal dkar rnams kan rkyal du bkram pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa/ lho ru brgya byin/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje sngon po/ shar lhor gnod sbyin ser po/ lho nub tu srin po smug naganub byang du lha min thags bzang ris ljang khu rnams kan rkyal du gnas pa'i snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ sgo bzhir nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi dwags kyi gdan re re'o/ /dbus su rang sems hūṃ dang aṃ nag po/ de'i 'og tu mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ḍa ḍha da dha la ya/ phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du yi ge gnyis zhugs te/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa dang aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan par gyur pa ni so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog mthing nag

zhal brgyad pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi phye ba/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ zhal nas hūṃ spro ba/ lha dang lha min thams cad sdigs par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs pa/ drag po chen po rtsa ba'i zhal nag po/ g.yas dkar ba g.yon dmar ba steng zhal du ba'i mdog can/ lhag ma zhal bzhin nag la/ dbu skra ser po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan can smin ma yon po dang bcas shing*/ khro gnyer dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ban+dhu ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na ral gri/ gsum pa na mda' dang*/ bzhi pa na 'khor lo/ lnga pa na bshor/ drug pa na dbyug pa/ bdun pa na rtse gsum/ brgyad pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na pad+ma/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /lnga pa na thod pa/ drug pa na rin po che/ bdun pa na sdigs mdzub/ brgyad pa na zhags pa bsnams pa/ sku la rus pa'i phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa/ khrag 'dzag mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas brkyang gi stabs dang*/ rgyab ma gnyis skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ drag po dang*/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod dang drag shul 'jigs su rung*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo drag mo chen mo lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu bsnams pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang mgo bo skam po lnga'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa 'od kyi khyab par mdzad pa 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'o/

/yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa la lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ badz+ra mahā dwe ṣa tsa tur ā nan+ta dā ya ka kha kha mu kha a ka ra so nā tha hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣa me/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar aṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ pad+ma su kha dha ra mahā rā ga su khaṃ dang tsa tur ā nan+ta bhā ga bi shwa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ kār+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa spyan drangs yab kyi zhal nas zhugs nas thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar babs pa'i thig le cha bcu gnyis su gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te so so'i gdan la 'khod pa nyi zla kha sbyor bcu gnyis su gyur/ de rnams kyi bar du gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las gri gug dang cang te'u ral gri dang thod pa rin po che dang rdo rje rlung ras dang thod pa lcags kyu dang zhags pa lcags sgrog dang dril bu rnams sa bon de rnams kyis mtshan pa/ zla nyi so so dang gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du gau ri nag mo g.yas gnyis gri gug dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis kyi thod pa dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau rī dmar mo g.yas gnyis ḍā ma ru dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis thod pa dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai tā li ser mo g.yas gnyis ral gri dang chang bum/ g.yon gnyis su dung chos dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du ghisma rī ljang khu g.yas gnyis thod zhags dang skyabs sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dgra sta dang me thab 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī sngon mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor shā bā ri dkar mo g.yas gnyis rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga

/g.yon gnyis thod pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu tsaṇ+ḍā li sngon mo g.yas gnyis rlung ras dang thod pa/ g.yon gnyis ba dan dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du ḍoṃ bi nā+-i sna tshogs mdog g.yas gnyis thod pa dang bshor/ g.yon gnyis mdung rtse gsum dang sa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ shar sgor rta gdong ma nag mo zhal bzhi nag ser dmar ba'i steng na rta gdong ljang khu rtsa phyag gnyis kyis gling bu/ tha ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser po zhal bzhi ser sngo dkar ba'i steng na phag gdong dmar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis pi waṃ/ tha ma gnyis kyis rin po che dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo zhal bzhi dmar sngo dkar ba'i steng na khyi gdong ser mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rnga bo che/ tha ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor seng gdong ma ljang khu zhal bzhi/ ljang nag dmar ba'i steng na seng gdong dkar mo rtsa phyag gnyis kyis rdza rnga/ tha ma gnyis kyi ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha mo thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen tu brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu brgyan cing*/ skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang*/ rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ sgo ma rnams ni sbom thung cher khros shing stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can no/ /

de nas/ gtso bo'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ gtsug tor dang lte bar hoḥdamar po res mtshan par gyur/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu nas bdud bzhi'i steng du/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin thig le gnyis su gyur/ de nas tshad med pa bzhi'i ngo bor gyur pa'i lha mo bzhi'i snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba'i don la bskul ba ni/ puk+ka sīs/ rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī nī bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed mdzod/ / shā bā ris/ khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ / tsaṇ+ḍā lis/ dga' gtso 'jig rten don gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ ḍoṃ bi nis/ bdag gis nyid kyi thugs 'tshal gyi/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag nyid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig ces bskul bas/ thig le gnyis po gcig tu 'dres te nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su hūṃ dang aṃ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūṃ dang aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nag= sogs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa yum bcas ltar gsal btab po/ /de ltar bdag nyid dgyes mdzad du gyur pa'i sku la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa'i steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i thugs kyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad dang bcas pa'i lte ba la nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi'i gdan/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du tshangs pa/

lhor dbang po/ nub tu nye dbang*/ byang du drag po/ byang shar du gshin rje/ shar lhor nor bdag /lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du thags bzang ris/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje sku mdog mthing nagazhal brgyad pa= nas/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa brgyad na/ glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ glang*/ rnga mo/ mi/ sha ra bha/ byi la rnams so/ /g.yon pa brgyad na/ sa'i lha mo/ chu lha/ me lha/ rlung lha/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ gshin rje/ gnod sbyin rnams so/ /sku la phyag rgya drug dang ldan pa = nas/ nye dbang rnams mnyam par mnan pa/ gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa/ de la 'khyud pa'i bdag med ma nag mo drag mo chen mo lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa/ phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga dang*/ mgo bo skam po'i phreng ba can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis rjes su chags pa/ lhag ma bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs shing*/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du gau ri nag mo g.yas gri gug g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ lhor chom rkun ma dmar mo g.yas ḍā ma ru g.yon phag pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu ro langs ma ser mo g.yas ru sbal g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang du nus ma ljang khu g.yas sbrul g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sbos mo sngon po g.yas seng ge g.yon dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lhor ri khrod ma dkar mo g.yas dge slong g.yon sil byed 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol ba mo sngon mo g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa g.yas rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang dbu skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ spyan dmar po gsum dang ldan pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lnga ldan g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bor bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo dkar po 'dab ma so gnyis pa'i steng du dgyes mdzad kyi sku'i snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/

dbus la che dgu pa snam bu rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa/ dbus dang khro bcu'i gnas su nyi gdan dkar po/ shar phyogs pa rnams la zla ba/ mā ma kī la rdo rje/ gzhan lho phyogs pa rnams la rin po che/ nub phyogs pa rnams la pad+ma dmar po/ byang phyogs pa rnams la sna tshogs rdo rje'i gdan/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo pad+ma/ g.yon pa rnams kyi dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis 'khyud rgyas yum reg bya rdo rje ma rang dang 'dra ba pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ re mig rnams la shar du rnam snang dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje pad dkar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu nor bu ral gri 'dzin pa/ lhor rin 'byung ser po ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis nor bu rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ser ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang du don grub ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu pad ljang nor bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis 'khor lo rdo rje ut+pal dkar po/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma kī sngon mo sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/

phyag drug gis g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo ut+pal sngo dmar/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkar mo dmar mo dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yon gyi dang po dril bu dkur bsten pas ut+pal dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa g.yas kyi dang pos kha 'byed pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje ut+pal sngon po rdo rje mtshan pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis dril bu rin chen ral gri 'dzin pa/ rim pa gnyis pa'i shar lhor gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis me long dmar po 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu sgra rdo rje ma sngon mo mā ma kī dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis pi waṃ sngon po 'dzin pa/ nub byang du dri rdo rje ma dmar mo 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du ro rdo rje ma ljang khu sgrol ma dang 'dra ba las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ro drug gi gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ rim pa gsum pa'i lha snam la/ shar sgo'i g.yas su byams pa rnam snang dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas kyi dang pos klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa 'khor los mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ shar sgo'i g.yon du sa'i snying po rnam snang dang 'dra ba/ lho sgo'i g.yas su phyag na rdo rje dang g.yon du nam mkha'i snying po gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan lta bu/ nub sgo'i g.yas su 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ g.yon du 'jam dpal 'od dpag med dang 'dra ba/ byang sgo'i g.yas su sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ g.yon du kun tu bzang po don grub lta bu/ lha yab rnams thams cad ral pa'i thor tshugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa/

yum rnams dbu skra phyed bcings su byas pa/ sgeg cing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ zur gyi lta ba la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis mdzes pa/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' bas rol pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung dang*/ gzhan rnams sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ thams cad dar gyi na bza' dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /shar sgor gshin rje mthar byed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis tho ba 'khor lo rdo rje/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ lho sgor shes rab mthar byed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ nub sgor rta mgrin dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyi pad+ma ral gri gtun shing*/ g.yon snyems pa dang bcas pas dril bu dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin pa/ byang sgor bgegs mthar byed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis sna tshogs rdo rje 'khor lo gtun shing*/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub dril bu dgra sta 'dzin pa/ shar lho'i grwar mi g.yo ba nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri rdo rje 'khor lo/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dgra sta zhags pa/ lho nub kyi grwar 'dod rgyal sngon po rin 'byung gi dbu rgyan can sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag rgya can/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje dang ral gri/ g.yon zhags pa dang lcags kyu/ nub byang gi grwar dbyug sngon can sngon po 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po ral gri 'khor lo/

g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma dgra sta/ byang shar gyi grwar stobs po che sngon po don grub kyi dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa nag po ral gri 'khor lo/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa zhags pa rtse gsum dgra sta/ steng gi ya phugs kyi nang du gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba sngon po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ sngo dkar dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya/ lhag ma g.yas rdo rje pad+ma/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang ral gri/ 'og tu sa gzhi'i nang du gnod mdzes nag po mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i 'khor lo rin chen/ g.yon thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub pad+ma ral gri/ khro bo thams cad kyang stobs chen pha rol gnon pa spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis pad nyi la bzhugs pa/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i me stag 'bar ba dang bcas pas gdug pa can tshar gcod pa'o/ /mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i steng du/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje gsung gi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la sgyu 'phrul chen mo lha lngar gyur pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka sngon po sngo ser dmar ljang ba'i zhal phyag dang po gnyis thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ka bsnams pas/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo dmar ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal can la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu/ khro chags sgegs la 'jigs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum gsum dmar zhing g.yo ba/

skra ser gyen brdzes thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ phyag rgya lnga dang gar dgu'i rol pa/ thal chen gyis byugs shing mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs kyis/ nyi ma'i steng du mi ro'i snying gar mnan pa me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo sngo ser dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rdo rje dril bu kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa bsnams pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo ser sngo dkar ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis rin chen ce spyang ba dan mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar dmar dkar ser ljang ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis pad+ma thod pa gzhu dang mda' bsnams pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu ljang ser dkar sngo ba'i zhal/ phyag bzhis ral gri zhags pa ka pā la ḍā ma ru bsnams pa/ lha mo lnga ni thal ba dang bral ba/ lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa/ mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi'o/ /lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo ser po rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi'i steng du/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i yon tan gyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du/ sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor los mu 'khyud can/ de'i lte bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+ma'i mu khyud can/ de'i lte bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rje'i mu khyud can/ gsum ka'ang rtsibs brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus su bde chen 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu 'khyud la gri gug gi phreng ba can/ sgo mtshams brgyad du ro'i gdan sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal mthing ga /g.yon ljang*/

rgyab dmar/ g.yas ser ba/ zhal re re la dmar zhing g.yo ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i lpags rlon stod g.yogs su gyon pa/ lhag ma g.yas rnams kyis ḍā ma ru dgra sta rtse gsum gri gug g.yon pa rnams kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs la sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ zla ba phyed pa dang*/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu rgyan can/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol zhing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yab la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lnga dang mgo phreng gis brgyan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ khrag la dgyes zhing zla mtshan dang bcas pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma rnams la shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang gu/ nub tu dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngon mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa/

'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa ste/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni ro'i gdan dang bcas pa/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma la bum pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'o/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pul+li ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ byang phyogs dzā lan+dha rar mahā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lhor gau da wa ri su ra bai ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub rismi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang ling ga'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bār rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kā ma ru par aṃ ku ri dang e ra bā ti/ byang phyogs o drer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ nub phyogs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lhor ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sh+ye ma de bī/ lho nub lam pā kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang kañcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma lar mig mi bzang dang khā gā na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ / sku'i 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hī/ nub phyogs sau raṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shon+ṭiṃ nī/ lho phyogs su war+ṇa dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lhor na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/

lho nub sin+dhu ra pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor lo'i bsgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu trar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang rnam pa mtshungs pa ste/ zhal gcig phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo dang rnam pa mtshungs pa ste/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa bsnams pa'o/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo ljang khu rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi steng du dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i phrin las kyi snang cha gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus kyi lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje/ steng thog re'u mig dgur phub pa dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu phyag sum cu so bzhi/ zhabs bcu drug pa/ rtsa zhal nag po ma he'i gdong can shin tu khros pa/ pheṃ ka ra'i sgra chen po 'brug ltar sgrog pa/ de'i steng na srin po'i zhal dmar po bzhad cing mche ba gtsigs pa/ de'i steng na 'jam dpal gyi zhal ser po 'dzum zhing cung zad khros pa/ gzhon nu'i rgyan can/ rwa'i g.yas phyogs kyi zhal dang po sngon po/ gnyis pa dmar po/ gsum pa ser po ste mnga' bdag gi zhal gsum shin tu khros pa/ rā'i g.yon phyogs kyi zhal dang po dkar po/ gnyis pa dud kha/ gsum pa nag po ste zhal gsum ka'ang gtsigs pa'o/ khro zhal rnams smin ma dang sma ra dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ gri gug 'phang mdung gtun shing chu gri rdo rje rtse gcig pa dgra s+t+wa mdung mda' lcags kyu dbyug pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'khor lo rdo rje rtse lnga pa rdo rje tho ba ral gri rnge'u chung bsnams pa/

g.yon pa'i phyag bcu drug gis rim pa bzhin du/ thod khrag tshangs pa'i mgo bo phub zlum rkang pa rdo rje'i zhags pa gzhu rgyu ma rdo rje dril bu lag pa ro ras skyes bu gsal shing la btsugs pa me thab thod tshal/ sdigs mdzub 'phan rtse gsum pa rlung ras bsnams pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyi sa glang po che'i lpags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ phyag dang bo gnyis phyag mtshan thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin cing 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /zhabs bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad bskum pas rim pa bzhin du mi dang ma he dang glang dang bong bu dang rnga mong dang khyi dang lug dang wa rnams mnan pa/ g.yon brgyad brkyang bas rim pa bzhin du bya rgod dang 'ug pa dang khra dang bya rog dang ne tso dang khyung dang ri skeg dang bzhad rnams mnan pa/ de rnams kyi 'og tu tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams bsgyel zhing kha sbub tu mnan pa/ dbu re re la thod pa skam po lnga lngas dbu rgyan cing rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bu rak+ta'i thig le/ zhag gi zo ris rnams kyis mtshan pa/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo phyag g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba/ g.yon khrag chen gyis gang ba'i thod pa yan la stob pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum drag mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ gcer bu skra ser 'khyil ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang brlan bral gyi mgo phreng gis cod pan dang*/ do shal du brgyan pa/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis yab la 'khril pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs rdzogs pa'i 'od kyi nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'o/

/shar du gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud cing*/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis 'khor lo dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po ser nag dkar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis rin po che dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub tu 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ byang du phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsar tsi ka dkar mo gti mug gshin rje gshed lta bu/ lho nub tu phag mo ser mo dbu'i steng du phag zhal gyen du lta ba dang bcas pa ser sna gshin rje gshed lta bu/ nub byang du dbyangs can ma dmar mo 'dod chags gshin rje gshed lta bu/ byang shar du gau ri ljang khu phrag dog gshin rje gshed lta bu/ de ltar lha mo bzhi po rang snang gi thabs la 'khyud pa'o/ /shar sgor tho ba gshin rje gshed nag po nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis tho ba dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lho sgor dbyug pa gshin rje gshed dkar po dkar nag dmar pa'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/

lhag ma g.yas gnyis dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis pad+ma dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ nub sgor pad+ma gshin rje gshed dmar po dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis pad+ma dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis 'khor lo rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang sgor ral gri gshin rje gshed ljang khu ljang nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis ral gri dang 'khor lo/ g.yon gnyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ 'khor rnams thams cad rgyan dang cha lugs bcom ldan 'das dang mtshungs pa ste/ 'on kyang lha mo bzhi ni bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa las g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /phyi'i grwa bzhir ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bzhi dang bcas pa'o/ /rang dgyes mdzad rdo rje mtshon cha can gyi thugs kar pad nyid la hūṃ lha mo bcu gsum gyi thugs kar pad zla la/ aṃ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ḍaṃ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrnams 'khor par gyur/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dgyes mdzad mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ shar phyogs kyi dur khrod chen po'i thad kyi steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs/

tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis yang dag par mchod/ phyi mchod mchod do/ /spro na 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin gyis rlabs la 'bul/ bsdu na/ dgyes mdzad snying po lan gnyis dang*/ gtso bo gzhan bzhi'i snying po lan re brjod la/ mthar 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ṇa badz+ra swā bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ de thams cad kyang sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med par shes par byas nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag / oṃ badz+ra go rī a kar+wa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra be sha ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra be ta lī ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wā shaṃ ku ru ho/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lan lnga/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dam tshig sems dpa' ro gcig tu gyur/ dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha thams cad kyi mig tu moṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar deṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje dmar mo/ sna la maṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ kha la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo dpral bar iṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ lte bar noṃ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rdo rje ma drug gi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te skye mched kyi lha rnams la thim/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi lus kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ oṃ la thim pa las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥdamar po de las 'od ze 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi ngag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te/ āḥl thim pa las gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can rnams kyi yid kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs bskul zhing bsdus te hūṃ la thim pa las thugs rdo rje ma sngon mo/ lha mo de thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ gri gug dang thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ rus pa dang mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa'o/ / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer sna lnga pa 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba yab yum byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo rig ma dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod pa gsum gyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la gsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /phrag dog rdo rje nga rgyal te/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje mgon po khyod/ / las rnams thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /thams cad rdo rje bdag mgur 'gyur/ / bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rjes bdag nyid can rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs ka nas phyung ba'i spyan ma dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ khro bo rnams kyis bsrung ba'i las mdzad byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang*/ rdo rje ma rnams kyis mchod de/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las gtso bo yab yum dang*/ gau ri dang*/ puk+ka si la mi bskyod pa/ tsau rī dang shā bā ri la rnam par snang mdzad/ bai tā li dang tsan+ṭa lī la rin chen 'byung ldan/

ghasma rī dang ḍiṃ bi ni la 'od dpag med rnams kyis dbu rgyan/ sgo ma bzhi la don grub kyis dbu rgyan/ de nas bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa'i steng du/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du kaṃ gsum las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las thod par dkar po stong gsum gyi khyon tsam gyi nang du/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar hūṃ las sna bas dang mchil ma/ shar du bh+ruṃ las dri chen/ lhor aṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+riṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khaṃ las dri chu/ dbus su na las ma'i sha /byang shar du go las ba glang gi sha /shar lhor naṃ las glang po che'i sha /lho nub tu haṃ las rta'i sha /nub byang du ṣaṃ las ce spyang gi sha rnams kyis gang ba/ steng du oṃ āḥhūṃ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros sna bug nas thon/ rlung gi ba dan la phog /yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ raṃ las me sbar/ thod pa'i rdzas rnams bskol/ zhu zhing gyen du lud pa'i mi gtsang ba rnams phyir phyung*/ steng gi āḥzla ba'i dkyil 'khor hūṃ rdo rjer gyur pa oṃ dang bcas te thod par lhung bas rdzas rnams lan bdun du dkrugs shing sbyangs/ yang rdo rje 'greng bur gnas pa'i lte bar ā+-i las byung ba'i zla ba la hūṃ dang rtse mo la oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum dang*/ ha ho hrīḥ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi ljags hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs shing gsol bas tshims zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

de nas yang sngar bzhin ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ lha mo'i 'khor gyis bcom ldan bskor/ rgyu dang mi rgyu khyod kyi thugs/ /sems can kun gyi don mdzad rnams/ /bcom ldan mchog tu dgyes rdo rje/ /zhal mdzes thugs kyi dgongs pa 'grub/ /thugs dgyes mdzod cing dgyes rdo rje/ /oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta stu ti ra badz+ra swabhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ hūṃ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo/ /thams cad dngos po rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad rang bzhin gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /kyai rdo rjer bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa che/ /sngags kyi me tog 'phreng bas brgyan/ /sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag phyag 'tshal/ / bcom ldan mgon po dpa' bo'i dbang phyug ni/ /bskal pa'i me dpung lta bur rab tu 'bar/ /ral pa'i cod pan dbu yi rgyan du bcings/ /mche ba rab gartsigs drag shul 'jigs pa'i zhal/ sku la gzi brjid phyag stong ldan pa po/ / dgra s+t+wa zhags pa kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung bsnams shing*/ /rab 'jigs stag gi pags pa sku la gsol/ /sku chen dud kha bgegs mthar mdzad la 'dud/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /bdud dang mu stegs lha min bcom/ /gshin rje 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags 'di rnams bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ aṣ+tā na nā ya/ piṃ gor+dha ke sha war+t+ma ne/ tsa turbiṃ sha ti ne trā ya/ ṣo ṭa sha bhu dzā ya/ kriṣ+ṇa dzi mū ta wa pu ṣe/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡· ༵ + ka pā la £© mā la a ne kan+dha la ri ṇe/ ar+dha ta kru ra tsit+tā ya/ ar+dhen+tu daṃṣ+tī ṇe/ oṃ mā rā ya mā rā ya/ ka rā ya ka rā ya/ gardza ya gardzā ya/ tardza ya tardzā ya/

sho ṣā ya sho ṣā ya/ sap+ta sā ga rā na/ ban dha ban dha nā ga aṣ+takā naṃ/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ sha truṃ/ ha hā/ hi hī/ hu hū/ he hai/ ho hau/ haṃ haḥphaṭa swāhā/ rtsa ba'i sngags so/ / oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hū?ṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra karta ri he badz+ra ya hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ aṃ swāhā/ de ni mtshon cha can gyi'o/ / oṃ āḥbadz+ra dhṛka hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥs+phar+sha badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ rat+na dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.a ro līka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dh-ika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo ha rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ dwe ṣa ra ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥgan+dha badz+rā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā sa badz+ra hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmeṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.āṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhri hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥsaṃ hūṃ/ oṃ āḥya mān+takṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyān+ta krita hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ pad+man+ta kṛta hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta krita hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ ār+ya a tsa la hūṃ/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dzā hūṃ/ oṃ āḥnī la daḍ+ḍa hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmahā bā la hūṃ/ oṃ āḥtsakra wārtahūṃ/ oṃ āḥsubha rā dza hūṃ/ de ni gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'o/ / oṃ āḥhri hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhri hūṃ/ de ni mahā ma ya'i 'o/ / oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥgaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥshaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥlaṃ hūṃ swāhā/ oṃ āḥḍaṃ hūṃ swāhā/

de ni mtsho skyes lha dgu'i yin no/ / oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ bha raṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa ni ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hriḥha ha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ maṃ laṃ paṃ tāṃ pu dza oṃ go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la ka hi/ pre gṛ sau so su na si ma ku/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes bde mchog gi sngags 'phreng bsdus pa'o/ /rgyas par na gzhan du shes par bya'o/ / oṃ āḥdhi swāhā/ oṃ ya man+ta ka hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+tīḥbi kri ta na nā hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥdzi na dzika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrat+na dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥ.ā ro lika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpradz+nyā dh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥmo hā rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdwe ṣa rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥrā ga rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā ti hūṃ/ oṃ ā muṅga ra dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥdaṇ+ḍa dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥpad+ma ḍh+rika hūṃ/ oṃ āḥkhaṭ+ga dhṛka hūṃ/ oṃ āḥn hūṃ/ oṃ āḥyo hūṃ/ oṃ āḥni hūṃ/ oṃ āḥr hūṃ/ zhes pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs kyi yin no/ /rgyas par mtshon cha can la/ 'phreng ba'i sngags 'di dag bzla bar bya'o/ / oṃ hriḥswāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ye sid+dhi pa ra ma yo ge shwa ri ka pā la mā dha ri ṇi ru dhi ra pri ya sh+ma shā na bā si nī hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ri/ kha ṭaṅgi mahā badz+ri ṇi ka pā la mā la/ mu ku ṭo ā kaḍ+ḍha/ sarba duṣ+ta da pa mā kaṭ+ṭa/ ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra pa ra dzi te pa ra ma gu h+ya ka pā la mā lā ni bhu te sarba duṣ+ta mo ha ni pri ye e h+ya hi bha ga ba ti badz+ra gu h+ye shwa rī/ ba hu bidha bi shadha ra ṇi/ sarba duṣ+ta ni bā ra ṇi hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bertā li kha kha khā hi khā hi/
